note: Risk appetite = the ground and the scoreboard. Per-org tolerance limit in GBP/year. Enforcement is binary here (Audit vs Deny): a control's residual risk-bought (ALE_warn - ALE_deny) above the org's tolerance MUST escalate Audit->Deny; below it, Audit is proportionate. This is the number that justifies the flip - never a timer, never a date. Ordering is locked by the-whole-model: ludlow strictest (Deny-heavy, long-life health data), driftwood loosest (Audit-heavy, short-life cart data). `platform` is marked `root_of_trust` -- it is a risk-bearer (see CONTEXT.md 'Role'), not an institution; ../verify/party/party.py derives the institution count as risk-bearer+adopter-but-not-publisher, so this fourth entry does not move it.

driftwood.why: UK retail, short-lived cart PII. Loosest appetite: carries up to £40k/yr residual before a Deny is proportionate.

ludlow.why: US health, HIPAA, decades-confidential. Strictest appetite: near-zero tolerance, so the same control that Audits in driftwood Denies here.

platform.why: The governance apparatus is the estate's root of trust, priced by the same engine it prices everyone else with (see honesty/reflexive.py). Strict band: a compromise mis-prices/mis-enforces the whole estate, so signed feeds + bounded proposer + the PR gate must be mandatory, not optional -- the model says so.
